# Show the 13.2 screenshots in the notes

## Context

The 13.2 notes carry screenshot slots as HTML comments (#19487, #19496). After the operator rejected the first Dock frames, the set was re-captured: each capability mid-gesture, with its previews painted. It is hosted in `neomjs/pages` under `resources_pub/website/release-notes/v13.2.0/` (pages #18 / PR #19). This leaf puts the frames into the notes.

## The Problem

The notes have no images. The Dock slot still describes the retired "torn into a window, then home again" pair. Grace's placement map (A2A, 2026-10-09) puts the new frames in three places in the Dock chapter and one in Cell editing.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md` on `dev` `a1f4695af0`:
  - Dock slot: the chapter opening;
  - *One document for the whole workspace*: the controls paragraph mentions the rail reveal;
  - *Green in emulation, broken by hand*: ends on the tab-header proxy shown over the target;
  - Cell-editing slot: the chapter opening;
  - Agent Institution slot: stays, pending the operator's own cockpit capture.
- The frames are served at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/resources_pub/website/release-notes/v13.2.0/<file>.png` once pages #19 merges. The Portal renders raw pages URLs, as the blog posts use them. The release-note link scan checks only `github.com/neomjs/neo` source links.

## The Fix

Markdown images, each with an italic caption that says what the still shows:
- `dock-d1-cross-zone.png` replaces the Dock slot;
- `dock-d2-rail.png` follows the controls paragraph in *One document*;
- `dock-d4-drop-zones-held.png` closes *Green in emulation*, captioned as a second window answering a held pane;
- `grid-cell-edit.png` replaces the cell-editing slot.

A new slot comment in *A pane can become a real window* holds D3 (a tear-out with both windows in frame), which waits on the film take. The Agent Institution slot is untouched.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The four images and captions sit where The Fix places them. The retired Dock slot is gone, a D3 slot exists, and the Agent Institution slot is unchanged.
- [ ] AC-2 Every caption matches its frame's receipt (pages #19's body), with no claim a frame doesn't show (D4 never claims both windows).
- [ ] AC-3 The PR merges after pages #19, so every image URL answers 200 at merge. The PR body names that order.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The notes render with the images on GitHub, and on the Portal's staging route at #14800's cut check.

## Out of Scope

The frames themselves (pages #18); D3's capture (#15252's film take); the Agent Institution cockpit frame; the blog posts' own embeds (#19492, #19498).
